comparison.scope: Read recent nine casual prompts and the earlier characters in this batch; compare all light faces after generation.

face.why: Friendly round dragon volume becomes a broad balanced oval face, wide chin, large rounded eyes and full lips; shared smooth dragon curves but distinct from Dratini and narrow Dragonair.

casual.scene: At an empty harbor safety-festival boardwalk under clear noon sunlight, an adult rescue-event marshal walks with balanced weight transfer and naturally separated empty hands beside her hips. Face toward viewer, slightly low camera, complete head and both hands in above-knee crop; moored empty boats and orange pennants behind.
casual.outfit: Opaque cream cropped sleeveless utility vest over an orange secure high-neck sports bra, high-waisted orange tailored cargo shorts and teal webbing belt, small curved antenna-shaped stud earrings. Bare arms midriff and legs; original adult event fashion with no real badge, logo or lettering, no armor or large wings.

casual.scene: Alone on a windswept coastal dune lookout in pale late-afternoon light, standing relaxed in front three-quarter orientation and examining the horizon with a small pair of binoculars lowered to waist height. Hands separated holding either side, both full hands and forearms inside crop, sea grasses and distant sea, no birds or people.
casual.outfit: Opaque teal sleeveless ribbed halter top with a cropped open orange linen overshirt and cream high-waisted hiking trousers, tiny orange bead pendant. Bare shoulders arms and a narrow midriff, soft practical travel clothes, no armor or large head ornaments.

casual.scene: On an empty indoor roller rink at soft blue hour, turning through a slow controlled skating curve with knees softly bent, torso and face toward viewer, both hands relaxed and apart at hip level. Complete head, hands and both roller skates inside frame, polished wooden floor and quiet pastel lights.
casual.outfit: Opaque orange racerback cropped athletic tank and teal high-waisted flared skating shorts over secure fitted undershorts, cream quad roller skates and small gold pendant. Bare shoulders arms midriff and legs; personal sportswear with no armor, antenna headpiece or wing cape.
